# noderings_organization (Data Source)

The organization the provider acts in.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noderings_organization" "current" {}

output "organization" {
  value = data.noderings_organization.current.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Organization ID.
- `name` (String) Organization name.
- `type` (String) `client` (buys infrastructure) or `provider` (sells it).
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether NodeRings has verified the organization.
